=== 01-plain-text.eml ===
  parse() -> Some(Message)
  header count: 7
  subject: Some("Plain text status update")
  from: Some("List([Addr { name: Some(\"Alice Adams\"), address: Some(\"alice@example.com\") }])")
  body_text(0): Some("Hello Bob,\r\n\r\nThis is a plain text message with no MIME structure beyond the single\r\ntext/plain body. Three paragraphs total, this being the second.\r\n\r\nRegards,\r\nAlice\r\n")
  body_html(0): Some("<html><body>Hello Bob,<br/><br/>This is a plain text message with no MIME structure beyond the single<br/>text/plain body. Three paragraphs total, this being the second.<br/><br/>Regards,<br/>Alice<br/></body></html>")
  text_body count: 1
  html_body count: 1
  attachment count: 0

=== 03-with-attachment.eml ===

=== 04-nested-rfc822.eml ===
  parse() -> Some(Message)
  header count: 7
  subject: Some("Forwarded thread")
  from: Some("List([Addr { name: Some(\"Irene Ionescu\"), address: Some(\"irene@example.com\") }])")
  body_text(0): Some("See the forwarded message below.")
  body_html(0): Some("<html><body>See the forwarded message below.</body></html>")
  text_body count: 1
  html_body count: 1
  attachment count: 1
    attachment[0] name=Some("original.eml") len=329
      nested message subject=Some("Original note") body_text(0)=Some("This is the original message text, now nested one level deep.\r\n")
